projects.title: File Organizer Pro
projects.description: An async, parallel, memory-efficient CLI tool that sorts files into category folders with checksum-based duplicate detection, dry-run simulation, structured logging, and end-of-run reports.

projects.title: QRForge
projects.description: A from-scratch, ISO/IEC 18004-compliant QR code generator written in pure-stdlib Python, implementing Reed-Solomon error correction, data encoding, mask penalty scoring, and PNG output with zero third-party dependencies.

projects.title: MailGuard
projects.description: A secure, async, CLI-based email sending system with encrypted configuration, structured audit logging, and bounded-concurrency bulk delivery.

projects.title: UUID Toolkit
projects.description: A production-oriented UUID toolkit that generates UUIDs (v1, v3, v4, v5, timestamp) and inspects/classifies existing UUID strings, async and parallel-capable, with full audit logging.
